title: Shortlist
draftNote: Built from a draft: the need is not saved

method.title: How the shortlist is built
method.match: Fit: the expected share of requirements met across topics, weighted by importance. The self-reported stack adds at most {{cap}}.
method.place: Rank: the fit combined with the chance that the candidate accepts the invitation.
method.category: The category is a hard cut: a grade below the requested one goes to close matches, an unconfirmed grade ranks below everyone.

filters.title: Filters
filters.confidentHint: The level has a small margin of error

blocks.unconfirmed: Grade not confirmed by the test

row.stale: Has not confirmed the level for a long time

list.keys: Arrows pick a row, Enter opens the explanation, S adds to favorites.
list.emptyText: Loosen the filters: drop the stack or the confident estimate.
list.noneTitle: No candidates of this specialization yet
list.noneText: Rebuild later: candidates take the test every day.

explain.stackNone: The candidate has not listed a stack
explain.unconfirmed: Not confirmed by the test: no fit score.
